confirmed_differences: 38 of 40 records are concrete ENT screenshot-comparison observations, not merely shape/model candidates. Each ENT record reports matching entity presence and stable position before/after capture. The two CANDIDATE records (item and pig) are expressly uncertain, for distinct recorded reasons, and do not establish defects.
This establishes missing body rendering in the recorded setup. It does not establish 40 independent root causes or a metadata/network receive failure.

The current mob renderer's mob_definitions() table and render-time self.mobs lookup form an explicit allowlist: in render(), a missing kind entry immediately continues without a draw. The listed kinds have no corresponding mob_definitions entry in pomme-client/src/renderer/pipelines/entity_renderer.rs.

The same base-model/texture registration omission explains the mob subset's absent bodies more directly than a texture-file failure: without a MobEntry/variant no model draw is enqueued, irrespective of whether a texture could load.

candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.candidate: Entity metadata handling contributes to all 40 body-absence observations.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.status: Not established; unlikely to explain missing base bodies alone.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.basis: net/handler.rs forwards scalar metadata generically as EntityData, while selected non-scalar variants are special-cased. entity/mod.rs applies known (kind,index) values. Missing variant/pose support could affect appearance/state, but a missing renderer entry skips drawing entirely. No inbound packet trace from these entity-specific captures was inspected.

candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.candidate: Missing model/texture registrations are the direct cause for mob-family records.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.status: Strong source-level explanation; runtime root cause remains unconfirmed.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.basis: entity_renderer.rs: mob_definitions() is the registration source; EntityRenderer::render skips any kind absent from self.mobs. The target list is not registered there. Confirming against the captured executable and per-kind received store state requires reproduction/diagnostic instrumentation, neither performed.

candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.candidate: Every target can be fixed by adding to the shared mob renderer.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.status: Rejected as an over-broad fix approach.
candidate_differences_and_root_cause_sta.basis: The range spans living mobs, boats/minecarts, display entities, and projectiles; distinct model/metadata/render pipelines are required. EntityRenderer mob_definitions is not an adequate renderer for every target. Shared renderer must not be edited as requested.

mob_models_and_textures.finding: No MobDef entry means no baked model, texture variant, overlay/layer, culling bounds, or draw record. Even correct official texture paths cannot render until geometry and texture are registered and the kind enters the draw path. Special layered/variant cases (e.g. shulker color/opening, piglin family, mooshroom overlay, magma cube size) additionally need metadata-to-render-state mapping.

vehicle_models.finding: These are vehicle/nonliving kinds rather than mob meshes. EntityStore has VehicleState and set_vehicle_kind, but the inspected entity renderer's allowlist is not a minecart/boat model renderer. Their bodies need a dedicated vehicle mesh/material draw path (minecart contents/variant and boat wood/chest state must be represented); adding a MobDef is not a sufficient diagnosis/fix.

projectile_and_display_models.finding: These need the respective display transform/item, potion bottle/projectile, spit, and shulker projectile model paths. The generic entity renderer contains an Arrow entry, not these kinds. Existing item-entity handling is distinct from ItemDisplay. Check packet-specific metadata handlers and draw extraction before implementing; no proof here that metadata failed to arrive.

mannequin.finding: No registered model/texture path was found in the inspected mob allowlist. Treat as its own mannequin/player-like renderer/state implementation, not automatically as a player entity; inspect 26.2 type and metadata schema before mapping.

metadata_receive_and_apply.finding: SetEntityData in net/handler.rs preserves scalar Bool/Int/Byte/Float/Long via NetworkEvent::EntityData, forwards entity pose/custom name and a subset of variants separately; EntityStore::apply_entity_data interprets selected kind/index pairs. Thus receiving/decoding, field application, and renderer consumption are separable stages. For these records the report verifies entity existence, not that a particular metadata packet/value was received. Do not mark metadata support fixed or faulty without tracing packet -> event -> store -> render info.

minimal_fix_recommendation: Do not patch shared renderer until the missing-kind stage is established. Instrument or unit-test extraction to distinguish: entity absent from store, kind absent from renderer registration, variant/state lacking metadata, and draw culled/omitted.

For supported mob family entities, minimally add per-kind model bake, official texture key/fallback, correct texture size, bounds, and only required metadata-driven state/layers to the existing renderer registry; avoid a broad generic fallback mesh that conceals unsupported types.

Implement vehicle, projectile and display types through the appropriate specialized pipeline(s), not by forcing all into MobDef. Share mesh/material only for demonstrably identical model families (boat woods / minecart variants) while preserving per-kind and per-metadata selection.

Prioritize deterministic, low-variant static body visibility first, then add metadata-dependent visual states in separate scoped changes. Keep each change away from shared renderer if ownership requires; document API/interface need rather than silently editing shared code.
test_plan_not_run: Per-kind ingestion test: synthetic spawn plus SetEntityData packet; assert entity kind, expected decoded variant/state fields, and the render-extraction output. Include protocol 26.2 serializer/index expectations and relevant legacy protocol translation if supported.

Renderer registration/draw test: assert each intentionally supported kind resolves a renderer/model and emits at least one draw for an in-frustum stationary entity; assert unsupported kinds are explicitly classified rather than accidentally silently skipped.

Metadata matrix: compare default and non-default state for frog variants, shulker color/peek, piglin-family states, magma-cube size, boat wood/chest state, minecart type/content, projectile/display item/transform; verify state selects expected mesh/material/transform.

Paired runtime regression: replay report summon setup against same 26.2 reference and Pomme, confirm before/after existence and unchanged coordinates, then capture same camera/time and check body present. Check shadows/white planes separately from body visibility.
